**Internal capability.** It is not returned by `GET /capabilities` and is not available to a normal reseller connection.

10 fields across 7 schemas. The fields are additive: the base schemas are unchanged when the capability is absent.

## Endpoints

This capability unlocks 3 endpoint(s).

- **`POST /identities`**: Create Identity. Body `IdentityUpsertRequest`.
- **`DELETE /identities/{identityId}`**: Delete Identity.
  - **identityId** (string, in path, required): Identity ID.
- **`PATCH /identities/{identityId}`**: Update Identity. Body `IdentityUpsertRequest`.
  - **identityId** (string, in path, required): Identity ID.

## Integration notes

Behaviour the specification does not carry, from [docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/identities](https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/identities).

### Routes this capability extends

- `POST /orders`
- `PATCH /orders/{orderId}`
- `PATCH /orders/{orderId}/preview`
- `POST /orders/{orderId}/confirm`
- `POST /bookings`
- `PATCH /bookings/{uuid}`
- `POST /bookings/{uuid}/confirm`
- `POST /gifts`
- `PATCH /gifts/{uuid}`
- `PATCH /gifts/{uuid}/preview`
- `POST /gifts/{uuid}/confirm`
- `POST /checkin/lookup`

### Rules and conditionals

- When creating or updating an order with nested `bookings` and `gifts` arrays, each nested item can also include its own `identityId`. ## Check-in Lookup With Identity When used with `octo/checkin`, check-in lookup can match bookings by identity.
